welcome1.message: Welcome to Star Wars CCG on DragnCards. This table copies the WARS/Decipher layout (Reserve, Force, Used, Lost, location row) with GEMP's card list. It does not enforce card text. Builder or Menu → Load puts a deck in Reserve. Deploy starting locations onto the location row and your Objective into play. A = activate Force, P = use Force, D = draw from Force, Y = destiny onto the Stack, E = Used under Reserve. TAB shows hotkeys. Card data/art: GEMP / starwarsccg.org.
